title: Choose the Staff app's visual world — bolder hand
question: Foreign forms at full commitment. The first dealt leads. Each sketch is the Clients list's first screen in that world.

options.label: The Care Score
options.lineage: Labanotation, the score that writes a dance as shaped blocks on a vertical staff
options.thesis: The caseload as a score: each Client's care a block whose length is its time and whose fill is its phase.
options.viewport: A black top bar; the Clients list on white with a care-score column: each row's care drawn as a block across weeks, hatched for intake, solid for active, dotted for postpartum, a violet line marking today.
options.case: Leads by deal. Birth work is movement work, and the block makes time and phase readable at a glance.
options.risk: Hatching and dot fills must stay legible at small sizes, or the score reads as texture.

raised.raise: One synthetic accent, violet, owns today and selection and nothing else.
A Client you mark stays circled until you clear it.
A changed state restyles its row and never breaks the grid.

options.label: Section Boards
options.lineage: boxed-software manuals with full-hue divider boards and a stepped tab rail
options.thesis: Every part of the Practice owns one full-strength color, and you always know where you are by the board you stand on.
options.viewport: Clients' board in teal fills the shell and margin; the list sits on a light leaf over it; a stepped tab rail of section hues runs down the edge.
options.case: Bold, total color commitment with real wayfinding; loses on audience: a software manual is not a doula's world.
options.risk: Seven hues app-wide can turn loud if a board ever carries content instead of place.

options.label: The Care Wallet
options.lineage: jet-age airline ticket wallets: carbon coupons, stamped states, one leg per sheet
options.thesis: Each Client's care as a coupon book: Intake, Contract, Birth, Postpartum, each stamped valid, used or void, and nothing ever disappears.
options.viewport: A navy top bar; each row's care as a strip of four small coupons, the current leg open, done legs stamped, a voided leg struck in red.
options.case: The audit trail made visible in the list; loses on audience: an airline is not a doula's world.
options.risk: Four coupons per row is dense; the strip must collapse well on a phone.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.viewport: A pixel headline over dense columns.
options.case: Fuses poorly: low-resolution type fights a tired reader.
options.kept: One synthetic accent that owns one job.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-size cells, your picks circled in pen.
options.viewport: A packed grid of tiny cells.
options.case: Fuses poorly: Clients are not thumbnails.
options.kept: Your marks persist: a Client you circle stays circled.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Rows ranked by time, flaps cascading on change.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a dark instrument board is a costume on a working screen.
options.kept: A state change restyles the row without breaking the grid.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What practice-management software ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A white app with a crisp data table, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
